capabilities: Search for movies by name via the TMDB API
Create movie notes with standard frontmatter and content
Download movie posters into the attachments folder
Generate a Base with views over the movie notes
extras: Author states the plugin is for personal use only, provided AS-IS, and is not affiliated with TMDB; it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Creating movie notes with accurate metadata and poster images requires manually looking up information on TMDB and filling in frontmatter by hand.

relations.evidence: creating and managing movie notes backed by TMDB data

summary: TMDB-backed movie note creator that searches movies by name and generates notes with frontmatter, content, and downloaded posters.
